meta.description: Execute a command as another user

positional.label: Environment assignments
positional.description: Environment variables to set for the command, written as VAR=value

positional.label: Command or file
positional.description: Command and arguments to run, or file paths when edit mode is enabled

mutex_groups.label: Operation mode
mutex_groups.description: Primary sudo mode options that should not be combined

mutex_groups.label: Shell mode
mutex_groups.description: Login shell and shell mode are mutually exclusive

options.label: Edit files
options.description: Edit files instead of running a command

options.label: List privileges
options.description: List the invoking user's privileges or check a command

options.label: List privileges verbosely
options.description: List privileges in the longer format, equivalent to specifying -l twice

options.label: Validate
options.description: Update the user's cached credentials without running a command

options.label: Login shell
options.description: Run the target user's shell as a login shell; a command may also be specified

options.label: Shell
options.description: Run the shell from SHELL or the invoking user's password database entry

options.label: User
options.description: Run the command or edit files as the specified user name or UID

options.label: Group
options.description: Run the command with the specified primary group name or GID

options.label: Other user for list
options.description: In list mode, display privileges for this user instead of the invoking user

options.label: Preserve groups
options.description: Preserve the invoking user's group vector instead of setting it to the target user's groups

options.label: Askpass
options.description: Use an askpass helper program for password prompting

options.label: Bell
options.description: Ring the bell as part of the password prompt when a terminal is present

options.label: Reset timestamp
options.description: Invalidate cached credentials, or ignore them for this command

options.label: Remove timestamp
options.description: Remove the user's cached credentials completely

options.label: No timestamp update
options.description: Do not update cached credentials even after successful authentication

options.label: Non-interactive
options.description: Do not prompt for input; fail if authentication is required

options.label: Prompt
options.description: Use a custom password prompt

options.label: Read password from stdin
options.description: Read the password from standard input and write the prompt to standard error

options.label: Preserve environment
options.description: Preserve the invoking user's existing environment variables when permitted

options.label: Preserve variables
options.description: Preserve a comma-separated list of environment variables; may be specified multiple times

options.label: Set HOME
options.description: Set HOME to the target user's home directory when permitted

options.label: Background
options.description: Run the command in the background

options.label: Close from descriptor
options.description: Close all file descriptors greater than or equal to this number before executing the command

options.label: Working directory
options.description: Change to this directory before running the command

options.label: Root directory
options.description: Change to this root directory before running the command; deprecated by sudo

options.label: Host
options.description: Run or list privileges for the specified host if the policy plugin supports it

options.label: Command timeout
options.description: Terminate the command after the specified time limit when permitted

options.label: End sudo options
options.description: Stop processing sudo options; subsequent text is treated as command input

options.label: SELinux role
options.description: Run with an SELinux security context containing this role

options.label: SELinux type
options.description: Run with an SELinux security context containing this type

options.label: Help
options.description: Display a short help message and exit

options.label: Version
options.description: Display sudo and plugin version information and exit
